name: Torus
description: A donut of dots seen at a tilt — Columns run around the ring, Rows around the tube. The near side of the ring grows and brightens, the far side recedes.
author: @swiftner

formulas.x: x = ({x:150} + 42 * cos(r * TAU / rows)) * cos(c * TAU / cols)
formulas.y: y = ({y:150} + 42 * cos(r * TAU / rows)) * sin(c * TAU / cols) * 0.5 + 42 * sin(r * TAU / rows)
